profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory founded in 2020 and operating as the applied research arm of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). The institute describes itself as a leading global scientific research center, and its public-facing work is centered on developing and releasing open-source generative AI models under the Falcon LLM family, licensed under Apache 2.0 and hosted in the UAE with Middle East data residency.

The Falcon model family spans a range of architectures and scales. Falcon 180B carries 180 billion parameters and was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, while Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, was described as the first open-source LLM released with weights for both research and commercial use. More recent additions include Falcon-H1, a hybrid model combining Transformer and Mamba architecture that the institute says outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and Falcon 2 11B, which the institute says outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B as verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. The family also includes Falcon Arabic, built for Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects, Falcon Perception, a multimodal vision-language model, Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model, and Falcon H1R 7B, positioned as a reasoning-focused model for mathematics, coding, and logic.

TII has also launched the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit entity dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI and building ecosystems around open-source projects. Related commercial activity involves AI71, described as a company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, which has issued calls for proposals and hackathons around Falcon 10B. The institute holds a verified page on theworldofai.org with no litigation or SEC filings recorded.
